# age recipients for encrypted database backups (db-backup.yml).
#
# This file holds ONLY public keys — safe to commit. The matching PRIVATE identity is what
# decrypts a backup; keep it OUT of git and store it in a secrets manager / offline vault.
# Only holders of the private identity can restore a backup.
#
# Set up (once):
#   age-keygen -o backup-identity.txt        # prints "Public key: age1..." and writes the identity
#   # copy the "age1..." public key into the line below (replace the placeholder), commit this file
#   # store backup-identity.txt in the team vault (NOT in git); delete the local copy
#
# You may list more than one recipient (one age1... per line) so multiple identities can restore.
# Restore: age -d -i backup-identity.txt backup.sql.gz.age | gunzip > backup.sql
#
